title: False Glory
text: “In any case, Amaki-sama, hero of the sword, you are the hope of Melromarc. Please continue to protect Melromarc, whose public order has fallen into such disarray. You truly are the nation’s representative, and its light.”
The Queen said this while gripping Ren’s hand tightly, forcibly binding him to an engagement with his fiancée.
“Amazing, Ren-sama! To think you’ve climbed all the way to becoming king!”
“We’ll lend you our strength, no matter what it takes!”
“Boo-boo!”

Ren’s companions cheered him on in this manner. And so… during the several days before the Crimson Swine was to be transported, Ren was granted some free time. It was then that a great change came over him, I say.

“I am Inult, the fairy of dogs and cuisine, woof! Keel, Luna! From here on, we’re setting off on a journey of adventure to a distant land, woof! We’ll master cooking and cause an uproar in the dark culinary world, woof!”

While Big Sister’s villagers—those from the Panda’s village in Zeltoble—were preparing to relocate to Melromarc, Ren had taken the initiative to transform into Inult and was calling out to Keel, who was together with Luna-chan. Incidentally, the sword was a kitchen knife that Father and the others had been using, one that Ren had recently gained the ability to transform.
“What’s wrong, Sword Bro? You hated being in that form before… and what’s with that weird speech tic?”

“Never mind that, let’s set off on a journey of cooking and adventure, woof! Far, far away—I’m aiming for a new frontier where not even a whisper of the sword hero’s glorious reputation can reach, woof! Luna, there I want to experience an adorable grand adventure, a romance, together with Keel, woof! Will you come along as our ride, woof?”
“Yep! Luna’s gonna have a fluffy rendezvous with cute little Keel-kun and everyone!”
“Excellent, woof! Then let’s depart, woof! Away from here, away from Melromarc!”
“Eh? But… I’ve gotta help rebuild the village with everyone back in Melromarc, don’t I?”
“Naofumi and his slave friends can handle that, woof!”
Father watched Ren, who was desperately trying to persuade them, with a look of pity.
“Ren… you…”

“I am not Ren Amaki, the hero and god of Melromarc who ended up becoming king, King Azott—I am Inult, woof! If you absolutely must know my true name, I’ll tell you. It’s Cerberus, woof! Under no circumstances am I Ren Amaki, woof! Now then! Keel, Luna! Let’s be off!”
“Waaait, wait for me! Luna’s taking Keel-kun along too!”
“Wha—!? Luna-chan, don’t just pick me up and chase after Sword Bro! What is with this atmosphere!?”

Ahahahaha… ufufufu… Ren went dashing off, trailing some sort of sparkling aura, dragging Luna-chan and Keel along. Making some sort of “vroom!” sound, arms spread wide as if beckoning them to come chase after him, indeed.
“Ahh… he finally fled. As a hero, or rather… he couldn’t bear the weight of the idol known as ‘Ren Amaki, the Sword Hero,’ crushing everything about him.”
“Shall we go catch him, then?”
“Hmm… well, I feel a little sorry for him too. Rafumi-chan?”
Father called out the name of Rafumi, who was nowhere to be seen. Then, from seemingly nowhere, Rafumi appeared.
“What, you called?”
“You were enjoying this, weren’t you? Since it’s your responsibility, you’ll take over Ren’s duties, won’t you?”
“Hmph. Do you really think I’d do such a thing? Chasing down the fleeing Azott and throwing him into the castle sounds rather amusing, doesn’t it?”

“Ren’s going to keep running, you know? And this is all your fault to begin with, isn’t it? Learn some restraint. This is your punishment—a lesson so that in the next world, you won’t play around this much.”
Under Father’s pressure, Rafumi clicked her tongue.
“Tch! To think he’d flee so completely. Well, fine. There’s still plenty of fun to be had. But I’ll make Azott work every now and then, understood?”
“He’s got a strong sense of responsibility, so if you let him blow off some steam, maybe he’ll do a bit of it… I’ll need to persuade Ren properly, won’t I?”
“Some hero legends end with the hero vanishing after saving the world, do they not? King Azott need only follow that example.”

“Doing that would shake the country to its foundations—that’s how irresponsible it’d be. It’s already rickety enough; without the idol of the Sword Hero, it might just collapse entirely. You’ve been so active and gathered so much support that the nation of Melromarc might vanish altogether if you left.”
Father, smiling, pressed Rafumi with the fact that, as things stood, there was no escaping this.
“You could plead ignorance and flee, but you are technically a hero too, aren’t you? Governing love, was it? Is there such a thing as such an irresponsible love?”
“You needn’t say it like that. Ahh… to think I’d end up having to clean up such a mess.”
“It’s self-inflicted, nano. Punishment for seeking fleeting pleasures, nano.”
“As if you’ve won some great victory, saying that with such satisfaction. Hah! I’ll withdraw at some convenient moment!”
The way Rafumi snorted derisively left quite an impression. I’ll need to keep an eye on what she gets up to from now on.
“It seems Ren-san has taken quite a liking to his Inult form.”
“Itsuki, in Ren’s case it’s more of an avatar, a disguise—unlike you, I don’t think he wants to quit being human.”
“If the result’s the same, does it matter? Still, I never expected Ren-san to attempt such a runaway. He hated that Inult form so much before.”

“Ren has an overly strong—in a bad way—sense of responsibility, so his stance is to avoid taking on responsibility whenever possible. The pressure of being the foremost hero, carrying the expectations of the nation and its people, was more than he could bear… no, if the cause were his own doing, he’d see it through. But since it isn’t, he runs.”
Ren’s retreating figure looked somehow delighted. For the time being, it seemed Father intended to turn a blind eye to Ren’s flight.
“Reeen-samaaa? Please come back before dinner, okay?”
Without answering his companion’s call, Ren simply went off with Luna-chan and the others.
“Even Ren’s companions don’t seem to fully grasp that this is Ren’s genuine escape attempt… well, I suppose we’ll just have to keep having Rafumi-chan act as his stand-in.”
“So it seems. In that case, Naofumi-san, won’t you be turning into a peckul yourself?”

“Have you forgotten the uproar at the castle already, Itsuki? Theo and Shion were already thrown into confusion, weren’t they? If I turned into a peckul in a place like this, with Wolf around too, it’d be a whole mess.”
At Father’s reply, Itsuki gave a small shrug just like Rafumi and smiled faintly.
“What a troublesome thing. The god of the demi-humans and beastmen, the Shield Hero, quitting being human becomes a spark for conflict among the demi-humans and beastmen.”
“Apparently heroes were originally sparks for conflict to begin with.”
“Has Amaki-dono gone off somewhere?”
“Keel-kun was just saying he was going to head back to the village and properly focus on the reconstruction, though.”
For the first time in a while, Big Sister appeared, together with Éclair and Big Sister’s friend.
“Don’t worry about it. Ren’s had… well, a lot going on, you know.”
“Is that so? The hero really can go back to the village now, right?”

“Yeah. Since Eclair-san restored its authority, it should be fine now. More than anything… I think the people who were basically running slave hunts have been wiped out, and the Queen’s been publicizing the wrongdoings of the Three Heroes Church, so the people of the nation are coming around too.”
“I understand all too well the pain of realizing you were on the wrong side. I wonder if these so-called superior beings, humans, can really swallow that bitterness and reflect on it?”
Itsuki repeated his usual mocking sneer.

“That part’s on the Three Heroes Church. I imagine it’ll turn into ‘we were deceived too.’ Try not to interrogate or mock them too much, alright? People aren’t that strong of creatures. And Siltvelt has similar issues too—I know that much, being someone who deals in the slave trade.”
Big Sister and the others tilted their heads, clearly not quite understanding what Father was lamenting about.
